review_scope: Fresh source-only review of the bounded one-new-public-IANA-audit Save runner against seo-identity-save-peer.json and the earlier one-row rerun and saved-row attribution blockers. No browser, build, test, backend request, or production source edit was performed.

addressed.evidence: saveAttempt creates the checkpoint with wx and mode 0600, writes and syncs the file, and syncs test-results before returning to the only Save click. It also syncs the repository directory after mkdir, covering a newly created test-results entry. Any sync error exits before the click.

storeObservedSaveId validates the real response UUID, exclusively creates a 0600 temporary file, writes and syncs it, renames it over the checkpoint, and syncs test-results. The old checkpoint remains a conservative no-repeat marker if the ID update fails before rename.

An existing checkpoint is checked for the selected on-device organization ID and exact public URL hash. A valid ID resumes read-only history verification; an absent or invalid ID throws before Save. Parse, mismatch, exclusive-create and sync failures do not reach the Save click. No code path removes the checkpoint or prior records.

The passive CDP observer correlates a real POST to wbx_seo_audit with the exact IANA URL and selected organization ID, successful response, loading completion, and returned UUID. The Save ID must match the rendered current-URL history row and selected snapshot before and after a new panel document time origin. A badge count or title alone cannot establish the row.

bounded_limitations: A missing or malformed CDP request body, failed response observation, or failed checkpoint update can leave the Save outcome ambiguous. The runner then refuses another Save and requires coordination; it does not independently recover the row from the database.
The ignored test-results checkpoint must be retained between runs. Deleting it outside the runner removes its one-write memory.
History-label collision makes the trusted pointer selection stop safely even when the correct UUID is visible.
T04 failure and retry, T05 second snapshot and diff, T06 empty/loading/error, and T08 changed-page diff remain unverified.

privacy_and_mutation.finding: The runner saves at most one new audit for the exact public IANA page in the explicitly selected existing test organization. It does not delete or update prior records, select a clipboard action, call a provider, inject a mock response, or log credentials, request bodies, or response bodies. The report and failure path contain bounded status, stage and booleans.

runtime.required_next_step: Root must make a fresh build containing the data-audit-id source attributes and root-owned resource guard, then perform at most one controlled real Save. Record the runtime result separately; source acceptance is not a T04 or T05 pass.
